name: Odessa-Ector Power Pipeline
monitor_reason: scope and status: a gas-gathering line (Yates formation gas from Ector and Andrews counties, later Gaines County) with a delivery leg to the power plant, announced February 2008 with no evidence it was built; sponsor and 65 mi length are sourced but a completion or permit source was not found. Gathering and unbuilt status fail the add threshold.
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: no Aspen, Odessa-Ector, or PSEG line in the existing roster (nearest are Hugh Brinson P3885 and Gulf Coast Express P0378, unrelated). One source, a Natural Gas Intelligence article dated February 28, 2008 (URL loads, names Aspen Pipeline LP, Odessa-Ector Power Partners LP, 20 inch, 65 miles initial length, service expected first quarter 2009). Note the evidence date of 2006 in the queue is wrong; the article is from 2008. The project is described as a gathering system for Yates gas with high nitrogen, delivered to the PSEG Texas 1,000 MW plant near Odessa. Not found: any Texas Railroad Commission permit, any later report of construction or operation, or any independent second source. Revisit only if a Railroad Commission T-4 permit or a completion report is found. Note the Odessa-Ector plant is now owned by other parties, so the 2008 sponsor may not match today's owner.
